#041 · Bat Pokémon

Zubat

Poison Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Zubat is a Poison/Flying-type Bat Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 7.5 kg. It evolves into Golbat. Its highest base stat is Speed (55), with a base stat total of 245.
